messages:
maria: Quick heads-up  I was auditing the model catalog and noticed Glimmer-3b's model card has a few customer-facing issues: the benchmark table shows a stale avg latency (50ms) but recent CI runs show ~38ms on our default profile, and the compatibility note still lists 'embeddings: experimental' even though we validated stable embeddings last week. Also the SDK example in the 'inference tips' section uses the old sync call and prints .text which is confusing.

aj: thanks for flagging. where does the latency number live? catalog index or the card?
maria: it's in the model-cards/glimmer-3b.md under the 'Benchmarks' table and duplicated in catalog/index.md summary snippet. think both need updates.
sam: I can open a small PR to update the table and the snippet. what should the new numbers be?
maria: use 38ms avg latency (p95=65ms) on our default batch profile (bs=8, seq=1024). add a footnote: 'measured on r-inference-rt v2.4, default compilation profile'.

leo: about embeddings: we ran validation for both float16 and 8-bit quant and the float16 variant passed quality gates; 8-bit still shows a small drift in cosine similarity for long inputs. I'd say switch 'embeddings: experimental' -> 'embeddings: supported (float16); 8-bit quant: degraded long-input similarity'. keep it short.

jen: on the SDK snippet, prefer v2 style and show streaming where helpful. propose this minimal example:
```python3
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.responses.create(model="glimmer-3b", input="Summarize: ...", max_output_tokens=256)
print(resp.output[0].content)
```
add a short comment above showing how to stream if needed.

aj: small request: add a frontmatter changelog line 'benchmarks: updated latency numbers; embeddings: clarified support; sdk-snippet: migrated to responses api' so we can track in release notes.

sam: drafting PR now. will also fix catalog/index snippet to reference the card anchor `#benchmarks` instead of the current `#perf` (which was the old heading).
maria: instead of changing the anchor everywhere, can we add a compatibility anchor on the card `### Performance {#perf}` under the current `## Benchmarks` header so old external links keep working? Our renderer supports `{#id}`.

leo: yeah that avoids breaking links in partner blogs. also update the bench table to show hardware column (a100-sxm vs t4) to reduce ambiguity.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4782  changes: model-cards/glimmer-3b.md, catalog/index.md. Includes: latency update, p95, hardware column, embeddings support note, SDK snippet swap, frontmatter changelog, and perf anchor shim. CI running.

docbot: PR opened by sam: #4782  CI checks running.

jen: CI lint: codeblocks must be labelled python3 (we used that), and the bench table exceeded the max column width in markdown-lint. will tweak table formatting.
sam: fixed table formatting and wrapped long footnotes. pushed. preview: https://deploy-preview-4782--docs.redwood.ai/models/glimmer-3b

aj: content QA: confirm wording on embeddings line. proposed: 'Embeddings: supported (float16). Note: 8-bit quant variants may show reduced cosine similarity on long inputs; prefer float16 for embedding quality-sensitive workloads.'
maria: that wording is good. added it to PR.

docbot: PR merged by sam  https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4782  CI passed, deployed to staging.

leo: one follow-up: our model-benchmarks CSV used by the /benchmarks page still has the old 50ms number. I opened PR #4790 to sync the canonical CSV so the public benchmarks page reflects the new 38ms.
sam: linked that PR to the docs change so release notes show both updates.

jen: small ops ask: can we add a short note in the model card about sequence-truncation behavior for the quant profile (8-bit) vs float16? customers asked about tokens being dropped at decode time.
aj: add a one-liner: 'Quant profiles may enforce conservative effective context; for long decode-heavy workloads enable chunking or use float16 profiles.' keep it terse.
maria: added the sentence in a follow-up commit and updated the changelog entry. pushed.

docbot: follow-up commit by maria on PR #4782  deployed.

sam: closing this thread  anything else?
maria: maybe we should add a short note in the SDK migration guide mapping generate() -> responses.create for the common patterns we changed. I'll open a tiny docs-ship ticket.

aj: I'll draft the migration blurb and include the streaming mapping. good work, team :rocket:
